stages.headline: Area tells how many unit squares fit in a figure; a unit square has side 1 (1 cm, 1 m, ...).
stages.headlineEnglish: Area tells how many unit squares fit in a figure; a unit square has side 1 (1 cm, 1 m, ...).

stages.headline: Properties: equal figures have equal areas; if a figure is split into parts, its area is the sum of their areas.
stages.headlineEnglish: Properties: equal figures have equal areas; if a figure is split into parts, its area is the sum of their areas.

stages.headline: Units: 1 cm², 1 m², 1 km²; 1 m² = 10 000 cm², 1 ha = 10 000 m².
stages.headlineEnglish: Units: 1 cm², 1 m², 1 km²; 1 m² = 10 000 cm², 1 ha = 10 000 m².
